1. Parties
This synthetic lease is between Elm Landlord and Fern Tenant.
2. Term
The lease begins on 2027-02-01 and ends on 2028-01-31.
3. Payment
Tenant shall pay rent on the first day of each month.
4. Maintenance
Landlord shall repair test equipment within 14 days after written notice, subject to site access.
5. Termination
Tenant may terminate the lease if the test premises become unavailable.
6. Governing Law
This lease is governed by the laws of Fictional Territory.
